author: DonaldMyTrump
body:
Greetings staff members of avicus,

My username is YouCantCMe, I also go by Zac which is what many of you know me by. I am writing this appeal for the infractions I received September 11, 2015 at 11:21 PM. The infraction claims that I was not appropriate on the forums. I do not know what exactly this punishment is referencing and no evidence has been sent to me. Please post evidence related to this infraction (if you have any). So I can better defend myself and so you can better defend this warn. I do not believe I violated any rules so if you could, please also quote the rules page when telling me the reason behind the infraction. I would also like to point out that the moderator that assigned me the infraction, Kavinsky has previously false banned me from TeamSpeak for "Toxic Behavior". Later Kavinsky even admitted the ban was false and said he wanted it appealed. This moderator exhibits extreme amounts of bias towards certain social groups in the avicus community and is not fit to be moderator.

Thanks,
Zac/YouCantCMe

title: Forum Warn

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body: Zacc, you were punished because the staff team decided your post was not appropriate, and in fact I archived it because there was a low tolerance for 9/11 jokes, and posting a song entitled "It's The Most Wonderful Time Of The Year" is not a way to deal with the situation. Your previous behavior has also led to this infraction, and was approved to be carried out. It's also a warn, so we don't typically appeal them, as they aren't a punishment, but rather a way to tell you to not do it again. As for your Teamspeak ban, already dealt with.

replies.author: DonaldMyTrump
replies.body: The song was referenced but there was no reference to 9/11 in anyway. Just because it is posted on 9/11 doesn't mean it has anything to do with 9/11. I actually posted that because I had been out purchasing Xmas presents for people and found a musical card. The song played by the card was "It's The Most Wonderful Time Of The Year" so I had it stuck in my head and realized how much I like the song. When I got home I saw the forum thread titled "What is your favorite song?" and felt like I should post that song. Please stop trying to justify an unwarranted and pointless infraction. Also since there is now a rules guideline that clearly points out escalations in punishments I do want this appealed since it is false.

replies.author: ViceTechnicolour
replies.body:
You see, you keep accusing me of biased behavior, but you keep sparking things up to cast me in a bad light. I would much prefer that in future appeals, you don't turn it on me and keep it relevant. Hate the punishment, not the person.

About your "holiday mood", I don't feel it's authentic. It's obvious to the team that you aren't able to conduct yourself properly, and if anything it came across as sarcastic. I've been familiarized with your personality, and even if you keep persisting to rant about my position or appeal more, it's not in your favor simply because of your actions and previous actions included. You've lost a lot of your credibility, and it's difficult to trust you, especially since you're the punished, and other mods aren't in favor of your actions.

replies.author: MidnightBeats
replies.body:
Hello.

I would like to apologize personally for any confusion or anger this issue may have caused. However, I am going to remind you that events such as 9/11 are incredibly sensitive topics for discussion, and we, as the staff team, highly disallow any posts that reference the event in a manner that may be deemed as inappropriate, rude or discriminating. Your post was seemed as a reference to the 9/11 attacks in a way that was inappropriate. Although it did not seem like that the song referenced the event, consider it like this. Why would a song with that particular theme be posted on that particular day? As for further reasoning, please refer to Para's post above.

This forum warn can also be considered a warning for previous posts. You have made a handful of immature posts in the past, and this warning can be seen as overdue. Please understand that this is just a warning and it's a reminder of what kind of behaviour you should not display on the forums.

As for the other part of the appeal, please do not target the staff member who dealt the infraction in the way that you did. If you have a problem with how a staff member moderates, please remember to contact support@avicus.net. 

Remember we have little to no tolerance for any inappropriate references related to any terror events. 

This appeal is denied. 

Regards,
MidnightBeats
Senior Moderator.
